MyHarvestHub.org – Frequently Asked 
Questions (FAQ) 
About the Platform 
Q1. What is MyHarvestHub.org? 
MyHarvestHub.org is a faith-driven e-commerce marketplace that connects Christian 
entrepreneurs, service providers, and buyers. Our goal is to empower Christian businesses 
by offering a low-commission platform where buyers can access affordable, high-quality 
goods and services while building a community of trust and faith. 
Q2. Is MyHarvestHub.org owned or operated by Harvesters International Christian Center? 
No. MyHarvestHub.org is independent and not owned, operated, or managed by Harvesters 
International Christian Center or any other church organization. While we are inspired by 
Christian values, we are a separate commercial entity. 
Q3. Who can use the platform? 
Anyone can browse and purchase products or services. However, we are especially 
designed to support Christian entrepreneurs, worship centers, and buyers looking to support 
faith-driven businesses. 
Buyers 
Q4. How do I confirm the authenticity of a product before purchasing? 
Buyers must carefully review product descriptions, images, and Seller ratings. 
Communication with the Seller is encouraged before making payment, as all purchases are 
final under our no-refund policy. 
Q5. Does MyHarvestHub.org offer refunds or returns? 
No. MyHarvestHub.org is a strictly no-refund marketplace, except where refunds are legally 
required under Nigerian consumer protection laws. Buyers are responsible for confirming 
authenticity and suitability before payment. 
Q6. Who handles product delivery and logistics? 
Delivery arrangements are strictly between Buyers and Sellers. MyHarvestHub.org is not 
responsible for logistics, shipping delays, or damaged goods. 
Q7. Are there buyer protections? 
Buyers are protected by the ability to report fraudulent Sellers. Fraudulent Sellers will have 
their stores closed, accounts terminated, and may be reported to authorities. However, the 
Platform itself does not issue refunds or intervene in disputes. 
Sellers & Vendors 
Q8. How do Sellers benefit from MyHarvestHub.org? 
We offer low commission rates compared to mainstream platforms, enabling Sellers to 
provide the best prices and discounts to buyers. We also provide faith-based visibility, 
targeted advertising, and community trust. 
Q9. What are Sellers’ responsibilities? 
Sellers are responsible for: 
● Providing accurate product descriptions, pricing, and images. 
● Ensuring all products/services are authentic and lawful. 
● Handling delivery and logistics directly with Buyers. 
Q10. What happens if a Seller is found to be fraudulent? 
Fraudulent Sellers will: 
● Have their accounts permanently terminated. 
● Have their stores closed without compensation. 
● Be reported to law enforcement authorities for prosecution. 
Q11. Can churches or worship centers sell or advertise on the platform? 
Yes. Worship centers can sell items (e.g., books, CDs, merchandise) and promote events 
through advertising placements. 
Advertisers & Corporate Brands 
Q12. Can corporate brands advertise on MyHarvestHub.org? 
Yes. Corporate brands can advertise products and services to our Christian community. 
Advertisers are responsible for ensuring compliance with Nigerian advertising and 
intellectual property laws. 
Q13. Does the platform provide discounts through advertisers? 
Yes. We partner with corporate advertisers to introduce discount coupons for our users, 
making high-quality goods and services more accessible. 
Q14. Is MyHarvestHub.org responsible for third-party advertisements? 
No. Advertisers are solely responsible for their ads. MyHarvestHub.org disclaims all liability 
for misleading, unlawful, or inaccurate advertisements. 
Platform Policies & Data 
Q15. Can pricing or subscription fees change? 
Yes. MyHarvestHub.org reserves the right to modify product pricing, subscription fees, and 
membership tiers at any time without notice. 
Q16. How does MyHarvestHub.org use customer data? 
We reserve the right to collect, use, and analyze user data for operational, commercial, 
promotional, and religious purposes, including targeted advertising. By using the Platform, 
Users consent to these practices. 
Q17. Does the platform promote religious content? 
Yes. As a faith-driven marketplace, we reserve the right to display Christian religious content, 
promotions, and event advertisements to all Users, including Buyers, Sellers, and 
Advertisers. 
Q18. Is MyHarvestHub.org involved in disputes between Buyers and Sellers? 
No. Disputes must be resolved directly between Buyers and Sellers. The Platform does not 
mediate or intervene but may take enforcement actions against fraudulent activity. 
Technical & General 
Q19. How do I create an account? 
Simply click on “Sign Up” at MyHarvestHub.org, provide your basic details, and choose 
whether you are registering as a Buyer, Seller, or Advertiser. 
Q20. Can MyHarvestHub.org suspend or terminate my account? 
Yes. We reserve the right to suspend, restrict, or terminate any account that violates our 
Terms & Conditions, engages in fraud, or breaches Nigerian law.
